_source: Deliverable bullets added by the PRD coverage-closure pass (2026-10-22). Each closes GAP/PARTIAL rows from docs/prd/coverage-ax.md §12.99 and coverage-sap.md §13.99; see each wave's N.W.21 Coverage closure table. Merged into waves.json by scripts/merge_coverage_additions.py.

Message templates (per language, sys/customer layers, placeholders from metadata and workflow context) and per-user notification preferences (in-app/email, digests, quiet hours)
